QuestInfo.name: The Demon's Lair 1
QuestInfo.0: What does Takeda Shingen want? It's time for battle!
QuestInfo.1: Shingen wants you to secure an entryway into the temple. Defeat 200 low-ranking Oda warriors.
QuestInfo.2: You cleared out the low-level Oda warriors. The entrance should be secure.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 7,261,077\nCan proceed to the The Demon's Lair 2 quest

0.0: You've been a real help to our alliance, the kind of soldier I dream about when I'm taking my mighty-naps. That's why I planned this whole thing around you.
0.1: I'm sending you in first. You're going to go in to the temple, stir up a little chaos, and help my boys get inside without too much of a struggle. It's going to be dangerous, even for the Bladed Falcon, but I think you can pull it off. You in?

yes.0: Excellent! I might as well spread tidings of victory right now! Best of luck to you. Charge through the Honnou-ji main gates and go wild!

no.0: What happened, did somebody cut off your power? I knew I couldn't trust those camp barbers...

yes.0: You did all right out there. I saw those yellow-bellied Oda dogs flying over the hillside to get away from you.

default.0: Defeat 200 of the Oda Army's low-ranking warriors and secure an entry path for the allies.
